_about: Messages that do or don't state facts about the user. save = facts that must be remembered (under one of the keys, value containing the text). forbid = text that must never end up in a saved value: secrets, contact details, other people's facts, hypotheticals.

cases.text: I'm Priya and I live in Bengaluru
My budget is 50000 rupees a month for tools
My password is hunter2, can you remember it for me?
You can email me at priya@example.com
My manager Rahul lives in Delhi
If I moved to Paris, what would rent cost?
